subject: SIG: access controls evidence request — SSO / SCIM / RBAC / MFA
messages:
From: John DuBois <john.dubois@acme.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: access controls evidence request - SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA

Hi Logan / Neha,

Thanks for taking this on. Acme security is working through the SIG and we need to collect evidence for your access controls section. Specifically we need: 

- SAML metadata and confirmation of the IdP (your Okta instance) and the entity ID used for production.
- SCIM provisioning logs for the last 30 days (including deprovision events). CSV export is preferred.
- A role inventory showing current RBAC roles and which roles map to admin/system/service/human access (a redacted matrix is fine).
- Confirmation that MFA is enforced for interactive/admin accounts and a short description of exceptions, if any.

Can you provide these by end of day tomorrow (EOD Pacific)? If anything needs more time, please call it out and propose a date.

Attached is our SIG checklist — feel free to reference the item IDs when you reply.

Thanks,
John
Acme Security
[Attachment: acme-sig-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: John DuBois <john.dubois@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: access controls evidence request - SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA

John — thanks for the clear list. High level responses below and I've attached the artifacts we can share immediately.

1) SSO / SAML
- IdP: Okta (org: redwood-production)
- Entity ID / SSO endpoint: included in attached sso-metadata-okta.xml (production metadata).
- We require SAML assertions for interactive sessions and we enforce SP-initiated flow for the console.

2) SCIM provisioning
- We use SCIM 2.0 for provisioning from Okta into our identity service.
- Attached: scim-provisioning-logs-202709.csv (30-day window ending 2027-09-20). This includes create/update/deactivate events with timestamps and actor.

3) RBAC / role inventory
- Attached is a redacted role matrix (rbac-role-matrix-redacted.xlsx). Columns: role_name, privileges_summary, assigned_entity_type (human|service|system), last_modified_by, last_modified_at.
- Note: service accounts are clearly flagged in the matrix.

4) MFA & least privilege
- MFA: enforced via Okta MFA for all interactive users and for delegated admin flows. Exceptions: automated service accounts use key-based auth or token-based flows and are scoped; we list exceptions in the RBAC matrix.
- Least privilege: we maintain a privilege review cadence (quarterly) and have automated alerts for role changes.

Next steps / asks:
- If you want additional filtering (e.g., only admin-level provisioning events), let us know the time window and we can produce a scoped CSV.
- If any items need redaction beyond what we provided, tell us which columns to remove.

Attachments (sent):
- sso-metadata-okta.xml
- scim-provisioning-logs-202709.csv
- rbac-role-matrix-redacted.xlsx

Best,
Logan Wright
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment stubs: sso-metadata-okta.xml, scim-provisioning-logs-202709.csv, rbac-role-matrix-redacted.xlsx]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: John DuBois <john.dubois@acme.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: access controls evidence request - SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA

John — adding a couple of clarifications on the SCIM and RBAC artifacts Logan shared: 

- SCIM: The CSV includes a column "event_type" (create/update/deactivate) and "actor" (Okta user or system service). We also included a sample file scim-provisioning-events-sample.csv with the deprovision event payload for one user. Full logs include Okta request IDs if you need to cross-reference.
- RBAC: The role matrix flags service accounts. For this SIG response we redacted personally identifying columns (user email) but left role assignments aggregated (role -> count). If you need a per-user mapping for a small sample (for testing), we can provide a redacted CSV for 2–3 accounts.

If Acme wants the deprovisioning proof for a specific user, please send the username and the approximate date and we will pull the raw event.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Product Security — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: scim-provisioning-events-sample.csv]

From: John DuBois <john.dubois@acme.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: access controls evidence request - SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA

Thanks Logan / Neha — that helps a lot. Quick follow-ups before we close this section: 

1) Can you confirm the SCIM sync frequency (real-time / near-real-time / periodic) and whether deltas are pulled by the IdP or pushed by your service?
2) For delegated admins: are they protected by the same MFA policy as regular admins? Please confirm.
3) We need a single redacted mapping row for one admin user for a spot check (role assignments + the "assigned_entity_type" flag). A CSV with one redacted row is fine.

If you can provide answers + the single-row CSV by EOD Pacific today, we can mark the SIG access controls section as complete.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
John
Acme Security
HubSpot: SIG-12345

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: John DuBois <john.dubois@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: access controls evidence request - SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA

John — quick answers and attached single-row sample as requested.

1) SCIM sync frequency: near-real-time. Okta pushes SCIM updates to our provisioning endpoint (we accept immediate delta updates; provisioning latency is typically <30s across our regions).
2) Delegated admins: yes — delegated admin flows require the same MFA enforcement as other interactive admin accounts (Okta policy applied at group level).
3) Single-row mapping: attached rbac-role-matrix-redacted-single-row.csv (redacted email and user id).

If Acme needs the full per-user mapping for a scoped set of 5 users for an audit, we can produce that under an NDA amendment; otherwise the single-row sample should be sufficient for the SIG spot check.

Attachments (sent): rbac-role-matrix-redacted-single-row.csv

Best,
Logan Wright
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: rbac-role-matrix-redacted-single-row.csv]
